name: Kaga Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kaga Electronics Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale of electronics parts, semiconductors, PCs, peripherals, and other products in Japan, North America, Europe, and rest of Asia. The company develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductors and general electronic components; and sells personal computers, PC peripherals, storage devices, various home appliances, photo and video related products, and original products. It is also involved in the production of CG images; planning and development of amusement-related products; provision of repair and support for electronic equipment; manufacture and sell amusement equipment; and sells sporting goods.
